name: B10-0406/2026 – After § 4 – Am 25
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 4c. Is alarmed by reports of sexual exploitation of migrant children; calls for the immediate transfer of unaccompanied minors out of overcrowded facilities in Ceuta to adequate child-protection placements, with the support of the Commission and in cooperation with the autonomous communities, as the most effective measure to protect them from exploitation;
